```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build_and_critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc

      # Web
      - name: Install dependencies (web)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: web
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: web

      - name: Lint (web)
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: web

      - name: Typecheck (web)
        run: npm run typecheck
        working-directory: web

      - name: Test (web)
        run: npm test
        working-directory: web

      # Apps
      - name: Install dependencies (apps)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: apps

      - name: Lint (apps)
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: apps

      - name: Typecheck (apps)
        run: npm run typecheck
        working-directory: apps

      # Electron
      - name: Install dependencies (electron)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: electron
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: electron

      - name: Lint (electron)
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: electron

      - name: Typecheck (electron)
        run: npm run typecheck
        working-directory: electron

      - name: Test (electron)
        run: npm test
        working-directory: electron

      # Claude PR critique
      - name: Claude PR critique
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful code reviewer. Provide a short critique of the changes in this pull request, focusing on potential issues, improvements, and overall quality. Keep it concise (2-3 sentences).
          system_prompt: |
            You are an AI assistant that reviews code changes.
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          claude_env: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        id: claude

      - name: Post Claude critique as comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const comment = `${{ steps.claude.outputs.conclusion }}`;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });
```
